Whether you're a resident, a business traveler or a tourist staying at one of the district's palace hotels, we offer a private driver service that matches your standards. Our drivers know the winding streets and shortcuts of Almadies inside out, helping you avoid the traffic at the Ngor roundabout.

Almadies Airport Transfer — AIBD with Total Peace of Mind

For your departures and arrivals at Blaise Diagne International Airport (AIBD), we provide a direct connection from your home or office in Almadies. Picture it: no need to hunt for a taxi, no haggling over price — a driver waits for you with a name board on your return, and an air-conditioned vehicle takes you home in comfort.

Why Choose Navette Xpress in Almadies?

  • Guaranteed punctuality: We arrive 15 minutes early for every pickup.
  • Premium vehicles: SUVs and luxury sedans for your business meetings.
  • Fixed price: No meter, no surprises. The Almadies-AIBD rate is confirmed at booking.
  • 24/7 service: Whether your flight lands at 3am or noon, we're there.
